purpose: Evidence register for EXP-008 through EXP-013, with the final conformance campaign kept separate from cryptographic security claims.

source_branches.evidence: Unit tests, fixed known-answer vectors, full 16-bit round-trip checks for three keys, permutation check for zero key.
Complete 256x256 component DDT and Walsh LAT; DDT max 64/256; nontrivial maximum absolute Walsh 128/256.
Exact enumeration of all 16 one-bit input differences and 16x16 weight-one mask pairs for 1..8 round prefixes, three fixed keys; explicitly restricted slices.
DDT Markov propagation separated from selected fixed-key full-domain differential observations; signed linear trails/hulls and direct Walsh checks.
Internal KS1 state-transition bijection for fixed context, exact inverse, deterministic related-key sample and output statistics.
Exact telescoping XOR identity; 256-guess preimage recovery on fully known 8-byte schedules; pairwise dependency and byte-delta related-key samples; artifact upload succeeded.

independent_conformance_campaign.status: completed; both EXP-014 CI jobs succeeded
independent_conformance_campaign.reference_implementation: independent Python specification oracle, not a second optimized implementation.

implementation_inventory.independent_oracle: Python reference_model.py, separate transcription of frozen equations
implementation_inventory.note: The distinct 64-bit ouroboros_step Assembly state transition is not an implementation of the 16-bit EXP-008 Feistel cipher.

security_boundaries: EXP-008 is a 16-bit block / 32-bit key educational cipher and is not suitable for real data.
EXP-009 results characterize the round function only.
EXP-010 covers only one-bit input differences and weight-one masks.
EXP-011 Markov differential hull estimates are not automatically identical to fixed-key differential distributions.
EXP-012 and EXP-013 key-schedule statistics are sample-based and do not exhaust 2^32 master keys.
EXP-013 recovery assumes the complete eight-byte internal subkey schedule is known; it is not ciphertext-only recovery.
Passing functional conformance tests does not establish cryptographic security.
